trello.name: Add queue depth alerting to worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet (not just payments), with consistent thresholds everywhere: warning at 1,000 jobs, page at 5,000 jobs. Do it in one pass.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with exponential backoff and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py (_process_with_retry). Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and route failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back of the queue instead of re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools for workers and API
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In one config change: bump the DB connection pool from the default of 20 to 100, and split the worker and API pools so they no longer share the same pool.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook: replace old Kibana links with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (one still routes to someone who left last year).

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout error rate alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Automate status page updates so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically flips to 'investigating' with a template message. Wire it to the checkout alert first; other alerts can be extended later. The status provider has an API.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a plan for a controlled chaos test of payment processor failover: staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The plan must be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until the review. Kofi leads and writes up the draft.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. The migration involves a config rename and changed persistence defaults, so it requires a proper change window scheduled with the infra calendar, not a casual Friday deploy.

trello.name: Write and distribute incident timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the incident timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow.
